newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia domestic fuel prices up.
newsitem.headline: Colombia domestic fuel prices up.

text.p: Colombia's Mines and Energy Ministry raised domestic motor fuel prices between 14 percent and 28 percent Monday.
The cost of regular gasoline at the pump was raised 14 percent to 1,088 pesos per U.S. gallon ($1.35) while the cost of diesel fuel was raised 18 percent to 1,126 pesos per gallon.
The maximum price of both fuels is regulated by the government, whereas the cost of premium gasoline, which has been liberalized, was increased by 28 percent to an average 1,856 pesos per gallon.
Mines and Energy Minister Rodrigo Villamizar said the fuel price increases would push February's consumer price index up by a maximum 0.76 percent.
